fine_trace.code: if (inp->m_vertices.size() > 3) { pMesh->mPrimitiveTypes |= aiPrimitiveType_POLYGON; } else { pMesh->mPrimitiveTypes |= aiPrimitiveType_TRIANGLE; }
fine_trace.note: Attacker-controlled OBJ face 'f 1 1 1 1 1' yields a 5-index polygon face (all indices equal) in MeshB; the importer records mNumFaces=1 and mPrimitiveTypes=POLYGON for this mesh and adds it to the scene.
The degenerate 5-vertex polygon projects to 5 identical 2D points; earcut emits no triangles (indices.size()==0), so no output faces are produced for MeshB.

fine_trace.code: pMesh->mNumFaces = (unsigned int)(curOut-out); /* not necessarily equal to numOut */
fine_trace.note: MeshB now has mNumFaces == 0 while it is still stored in the scene mesh array.
FindDegenerates resets mPrimitiveTypes to 0 and recomputes it from faces; since MeshB has no faces left it stays 0 and ExecuteOnMesh returns false, so MeshB remains in the scene.
MeshA (single TRIANGLE primitive type, num==1) is appended to outMeshes but pScene->mMeshes[0] is NOT nulled, so the scene still owns a pointer to the same mesh that outMeshes now owns.
When the loop reaches MeshB its mPrimitiveTypes is 0, entering the invalid-primitive error path.
The error-path cleanup deletes every mesh in outMeshes, including MeshA which is still referenced by pScene->mMeshes[0]; MeshA is freed while the scene holds a dangling pointer to it.

fine_trace.code: throw DeadlyImportError("Mesh with invalid primitive type: ", mesh->mName.C_Str());
fine_trace.note: The exception propagates out of Execute() into BaseProcess::ExecuteOnScene's catch block.
The catch block destroys the partially processed scene, invoking aiScene::~aiScene.
aiScene::~aiScene iterates mMeshes and deletes mMeshes[0], which is the already-freed MeshA (dangling non-null pointer).
~aiMesh reads the mVertices member (8-byte READ) from the freed MeshA object to delete it: heap-use-after-free READ 8, matching the OSS-Fuzz crash state.

issue_alignment.admission: OBJ input with two objects: MeshA (valid triangle) followed by MeshB whose single face 'f 1 1 1 1 1' repeats the same vertex index 5 times; the scene passes aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure and the TargetRealtime_Quality pipeline.
issue_alignment.source: ObjFileImporter::createTopology records the attacker-controlled 5-index polygon face and sets MeshB's mPrimitiveTypes=POLYGON.
issue_alignment.root_cause: SortByPTypeProcess::Execute appends single-type MeshA to outMeshes without nulling pScene->mMeshes[0], leaving the scene with a pointer to a mesh the step now owns.
issue_alignment.propagation: Triangulate reduces MeshB to 0 faces (earcut yields no triangles), FindDegenerates leaves mPrimitiveTypes==0, SortByPType hits its invalid-primitive error path which frees MeshA and throws; ExecuteOnScene catches and deletes the scene.
issue_alignment.sink: aiScene::~aiScene deletes the dangling mMeshes[0], and aiMesh::~aiMesh reads the freed mesh object (READ 8 heap-use-after-free).
